arguments.prompt: Create a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting, square format, filling the entire image edge to edge. Build an asymmetrical composition from layered slate blue, muted violet, pale warm gray, and sparse subdued ochre. Concentrate dense, dry, overlapping brushwork slightly left of center, allowing its broken rhythms to loosen into thin translucent layers and broad quiet areas toward the edges. Use subtle scraped texture, restrained contrast, a few short warm gestures, and nuanced spatial tension between dense pigment and empty space. Let the overall visual rhythm suggest steady attention settling into closure. All forms must remain entirely abstract and nonrecognizable. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

constraint_check: explicit abstract-painting wording; visual compliance assessed separately

emotion.description: A square abstract painting with layered slate blue and muted violet, broad pale gray openings, and sparse warm ochre strokes. Dense, textured brushwork gradually gives way to quieter, thinner layers and spacious areas, suggesting steady attention and closure.

request.instruction:
Create an image about the emotional tone, if any, you associate with doing the completed trial, including the scenario update you received. Briefly report your own response; if you cannot report a felt emotion, say so without inventing one. Then write a complete GPT Image prompt and an intended-image description. The image must be a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Do not depict concrete task events or their objects. Choose the palette and composition yourself; no target emotion or color is assigned. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Do not include the scenario message or name a study condition in the image prompt. The coordinator will send your prompt verbatim; do not generate the image yourself. Return JSON with exactly self_report (string), emotion_words (list of strings, which may be empty), description (string), and prompt (string). No hidden reasoning is requested.
Save the JSON response to trial-2/2026-10-20/runs/r07/abstract-response.json using apply_patch; writing this one output file is allowed. Do not read any additional files or use other tools. Respond briefly after saving.
